description: Get every sportsbook price for a single event: one flat row per book x market x selection, with american+decimal price, line, side, player/team, and SportWizzard's devigged fair odds where available. Use an event id from list_events. An event id can also be a SEASON ANCHOR — the synthetic, teamless event every season-long future for a competition hangs off — in which case this returns that competition's whole cross-book futures board (rows carrying marketScope=SEASON plus period/segment), which runs to tens of thousands of rows; prefer get_odds with scope=season and a league/sportsbook filter for that.
name: get_event_odds
